introduction: This package gives the service its memory: the hub's own audit events for every operation that has one, the per-run records agents ingest, one query that reads across both sources, the transcript rebuilt from traces, and a live stream.

glossary.agent event: A record an agent ingests about one run: an audit event, a session outcome, a tool call, a tool error, a trace event or a postmortem.
glossary.event bus: The platform interface that carries a recorded event from the component that recorded it to the components serving event streams.
glossary.hub event: An event the service records about something it did, with an actor, a workspace, a resource, an action and the metadata keys the reference lists for its type.
glossary.run id: The identifier of one agent run, formed of a date, a time and six lowercase hex characters.
glossary.unified query: The route that returns hub events and agent events together, newest first, with their times compared as instants so the two sources interleave correctly.

requirements.title: Recording the hub's own events
requirements.rationale: These events are the only record of what the service did, and metadata that drifts from the reference makes a consumer's filter silently wrong.

criteria.action: record one event for each operation the API reference's two event tables name, with that table's event type, actor, workspace, resource type and id, action and metadata keys
criteria.contract: for every operation in the tables, performing it records exactly one event whose type and action match the table and whose metadata keys are exactly those the table lists, with no extra key

criteria.action: answer a request the same way whether or not its event could be recorded
criteria.contract: with the event recorder failing, every operation that would record an event still returns the status and body it returns with the recorder working

criteria.action: record at most one bound-token refusal event per token per minute, counting the refusals held back since that token's previous event
criteria.contract: for many refusals of one token within a minute exactly one event is recorded, and its suppressed count equals the number held back; a refusal more than a minute after the previous event records again

criteria.action: return an event that belongs to no workspace only to an admin token
criteria.contract: a user's query and stream never carry a workspace-less event; an admin token's query carries them

requirements.title: Ingesting what an agent did
requirements.rationale: An agent retries, so a non-idempotent ingestion double-counts a run, and the access rule here is the reverse of the rest of the service.

criteria.condition: an audit event, session outcome, tool call, tool error or trace event is ingested for a run
criteria.action: store it and answer with its identity
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 with the record's id, run id and the fields the route's entry names; the record is afterwards returned by that run's list route

criteria.condition: an ingested record repeats an id already stored
criteria.action: answer as a duplicate and change nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 rather than 201; the stored record is unchanged and no second record exists

criteria.condition: a run id is not a date, a time and six lowercase hex characters, or a client timestamp is not RFC 3339, or a required field is missing or invalid
criteria.action: refuse the request and store nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 in the error envelope; in a batch the failing item is reported on its own; no record is stored for a refused item

criteria.action: check, for every ingestion route, that the workspace exists, then that it is not archived, then that the caller owns it
criteria.contract: an unknown workspace and one a bound token may not reach are HTTP 404; an archived workspace is HTTP 409 with error_type workspace_archived, answered before ownership is considered; a member or a stranger is HTTP 403 with error_type workspace_access_denied, not 404; a refused request stores nothing

criteria.condition: a batch of 1 to 1000 audit events or trace events is ingested
criteria.action: accept, deduplicate or reject each item on its own and report the counts
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the number accepted, the number of duplicates and an error naming the index of each failing item; an item's failure does not prevent the others being stored; an empty array is HTTP 400 and more than 1000 items is HTTP 413

requirements.title: The run's postmortem
requirements.rationale: A run has at most one, and a second submit from a retrying agent must not replace the first.

criteria.condition: a postmortem is submitted for a run that has none
criteria.action: store it and answer with its identity
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 with the run id, the run status and the time it was stored

criteria.condition: a postmortem is submitted for a run that already has one
criteria.action: answer with the existing one and change nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 200; the stored postmortem is the first one submitted

criteria.condition: a postmortem is missing a required field, carries an invalid run status or time, or names a schema version other than 1
criteria.action: refuse the request and store nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 for a missing field and an invalid status or time; HTTP 422 with error_type unknown_schema_version for another version

criteria.condition: the postmortem of a run that has none is read
criteria.action: answer that there is none
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with error_type postmortem_not_found

requirements.title: Reading a run's records
requirements.rationale: The reads are how an operator inspects a run, and they are open to a member where the writes are not.

criteria.condition: a run's events, session outcomes, tool calls, tool errors or traces are listed
criteria.action: return the matching records with the route's filters applied, paged
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the route's named collection, next_cursor and has_more; the order defaults to newest first and the page size to 50 with 500 the maximum; each documented filter narrows the result

criteria.action: admit a run read to the owner, a member and an admin token whatever the workspace's status
criteria.contract: all three are served for an active and for an archived workspace; anyone else is answered HTTP 404 workspace not found

criteria.condition: a run read carries an invalid run id, cursor or time bound
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 in the error envelope

requirements.title: The unified query
requirements.rationale: Two sources with separate clocks are the one place an ordering bug is invisible until someone reads a timeline that makes no sense.

criteria.action: return hub events and agent events together, newest first, comparing their times as instants
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with events, next_cursor and has_more; for interleaved hub and agent events the returned order is by instant descending, including across fractional seconds and differing stored precisions

criteria.action: narrow the result by the documented filters, leaving agent events out when a hub-only filter is given and hub events out when a run filter is given
criteria.contract: giving actor_id, actor_type, resource_type or action returns only hub events; giving run_id returns only agent events; source selects one of the two directly

criteria.action: return the events of every workspace the caller owns or shares an organization with, whatever its status
criteria.contract: events of an archived workspace the caller can see are returned; events of a workspace they cannot see are not; workspace-less events are returned to admin tokens only

criteria.condition: the unified query carries an invalid cursor or time, a start that is not before its end, or names a workspace the caller may not read
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 for the cursor, the time and the inverted period; HTTP 404 workspace not found for the workspace

requirements.title: The transcript
requirements.rationale: It is the one place a person reads an agent's conversation, assembled from records that were never written as one.

criteria.condition: a transcript is requested for a run and a node
criteria.action: rebuild that node's conversation from its trace events, in order
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with the run, the node and the messages; a session init becomes a system message, an assistant message an assistant message, a tool use a tool_use message with its tool name, and a tool error a tool_error message; other trace types appear in no message

criteria.condition: a transcript is requested without a node
criteria.action: refuse the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 in the error envelope

requirements.title: The live event stream
requirements.rationale: A watcher that misses events, or that one component's writes never reach, is worse than no stream at all.

criteria.condition: a client opens the event stream
criteria.action: serve a server-sent event stream with a heartbeat at once and every 30 seconds after
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/event-stream; a heartbeat frame arrives immediately and then at 30-second intervals; each event is delivered as its own frame

criteria.action: close a connection with no reads for 60 seconds, and drop the oldest event when a client's buffer of 256 is full
criteria.contract: a client that stops reading is disconnected after 60 seconds; a client 300 events behind receives the most recent 256 and loses the oldest, rather than the stream stalling or the service growing without bound

criteria.action: fix the set of workspaces a stream may see when it opens
criteria.contract: a user added to or removed from an organization during a stream sees no change in it; the change takes effect on the next connection

criteria.condition: any component of the deployment records an event for a workspace a stream is subscribed to
criteria.action: deliver it to that stream
criteria.contract: an event recorded by a component other than the one serving the stream reaches the subscriber, with no reconnection

criteria.condition: a stream names a workspace the caller may not read, or the configured limit of concurrent streams is reached
criteria.action: refuse the connection
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 workspace not found before the stream starts, and HTTP 503 at the connection limit; neither leaves a half-open stream

execution_paths.title: A hub operation is recorded and found again

steps.action: performs the archive and records one workspace archive event with the caller as actor
queries the unified audit filtered to that workspace
returns the event with its type, actor, resource and metadata

execution_paths.title: An agent reports a run and it is read back

steps.action: ingests a batch of trace events for a run, some repeating ids from an earlier batch
stores the new ones, counts the repeats as duplicates and reports both
lists the run's traces, reads the postmortem and reads one node's transcript
rebuilds the conversation from the stored traces and answers with its messages

execution_paths.title: A watcher sees an event recorded elsewhere in the deployment

steps.action: opens the event stream for a workspace and receives a heartbeat at once
records an event for that workspace in a different component from the one serving the stream
carries the event to the component serving the stream
receives the event frame without reconnecting
